title: feat(mcp): initialize instructions carry the governed-metric selection rule and the skills install line
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Part of #34686. This PR is the instructions half. The `/mcp/skill` single-source half (the served data-loop text rendered from the published ask-data skill, plus its pin test) waits for #34685 and lands as a separate PR.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：开放 MCP 服务器(HTTP)的 `initialize` 指令在默认文案后追加两段：凭据能用 `list_datasets` 和 `query_dataset` 时，加一段"先找治理指标"的选择规则；所有凭据都加一行技能包安装提示，版本取自服务器自身包版本。
- **为什么改**：客户端只在选中某个工具之后才读它的描述，所以写在数据集工具描述里的选指标规则，只跑过 `claude mcp add` 的客户端根本看不到。#34659 裁决 D5 = A：初始化指令带上这条短规则，并指向本地技能包。
- **风险与回滚**：只改默认文案，宿主注入的指令和 `instructions` 配置项原样不动，stdio 不变。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。指令从 98 字节增至 812 字节(有数据集工具)或 357 字节(无 `data:read`)。
- **先看**：`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`(`DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` / `openServerInstructions` 以及 `handleHttpRequest` 里的 instructions 那几行)、`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`(`datasetToolDescriptions`，与工具注册共用的那道门)、`packages/mcp/src/initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`，预期 7 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`initialize` instructions over HTTP** (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`). When neither the host's per-request text nor the runtime's configured `instructions` answers, `result.instructions` is now the existing default sentence followed by:
  - **the selection rule**, only when this request registers both `list_datasets` and `query_dataset`. It says: look for a governed metric first by calling `list_datasets` with the question's business words. A word matches only when it equals a measure's or dimension's name, label or synonym, never a similar word. One measure match is answered with `query_dataset`. Several matches mean asking the user, without picking. No match falls back to `query_records` / `aggregate_records` and says the answer is not from a governed metric. This is the same meaning as ADR-0149 D3 and as `DATASET_TOOL_LINES` (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`), which this PR does not change.
  - **the skills install line**, for every grant: `Published skills: @objectstack/skills VERSION`, then the `pnpm add -D @objectstack/skills@VERSION` command and a pointer to the package README for syncing. VERSION is `PACKAGE_VERSION` (`packages/mcp/src/package-version.ts`), which is how the package already reads its own version. `@objectstack/skills` and `@objectstack/mcp` are in one `fixed` group in `.changeset/config.json`, so they always share a version. It is deliberately not `config.version`, because that is the operator's `serverInfo.version` override (the plugin's `version` option). No line is sent when the manifest cannot be read, because an unversioned install takes the registry's `latest`, which can be another major's catalog. The ask-data skill is named only by its package; the skill itself does not exist on main yet (#34685).
- **One gate for the dataset pair** (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`). The new `datasetToolDescriptions(bridge, options)` holds the condition `registerDatasetTools` used to hold inline: the bridge carries all three dataset members (`hasDatasetTools`), the grant is unscoped or includes `data:read`, and the bridge defines a description for the tool. `registerDatasetTools` now registers from it, and `datasetToolsServed` (both tools present) decides whether the rule is sent. The runtime's bridge carries the pair only where the analytics service serves `datasetTools` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `resolveMcpDatasetToolsService` and `buildMcpBridge`). No change was needed on the producer side.
- **Precedence (measured choice).** Host-injected instructions (`hostInstructions`: the hosted door's `instructions` / `dataOnlyInstructions`) are untouched. The configured `instructions` option is also served exactly as written, with nothing appended, for three reasons. It is one string for every grant, so appending a grant-dependent rule would make it a different text per grant. The existing pins `mcp-server-runtime.authoring-scope.test.ts` "a runtime configured with instructions keeps them for every request the injection does not reach" and "…without it the configured text stays" state that contract. And no producer in this repository sets it: `MCPServerPlugin` is constructed without `instructions` everywhere in `packages/` and `examples/`, so `examples/app-crm` reads the default path, as the live reading below shows.
- **Stdio unchanged, on purpose.** The long-lived server's instructions are fixed when the `McpServer` is constructed. The SDK copies them in its constructor and has no public setter. `bridgeDataTools`, which decides whether the dataset pair exists, runs later in `start()`. So the stdio server cannot say at construction whether it serves the dataset tools.
- **Docs.** `packages/mcp/README.md` gains the two dataset tools in the tool list and their registration condition, `data:read` coverage of the pair, and a section on the `initialize` instructions: precedence, the two parts, and stdio. `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` gains the two tools in the tool table and a "Governed metrics and the `initialize` instructions" section, and the verify transcript now names the dataset pair.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/34686-initialize-selection-rule.md`: `@objectstack/mcp` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Instructions size, in bytes (UTF-8), for `result.instructions`:

| Grant | Before (`f02f4f63`) | After |
|:--|--:|--:|
| (i) admin API key, dataset tools registered | 98 | 812 |
| (ii) OAuth token without `data:read` (`data:write` only) | 98 | 357 |

Both "after" numbers were measured live (below) and in-process over a fake bridge at `ae5008be`; the two readings agree.

Out of scope: `list_datasets` matching and candidates. Separate cards carry them (#34761 spec, #34763 server). The instructions text does not mention a candidates list, because that field does not exist yet. The authoring (draft) tools are a later milestone of #34659.

## Why

The open server told a connecting client one sentence. Then it listed 17 tools (about 40 KB). The rule for choosing between a governed metric and an object query lived only inside the dataset tools' descriptions, and a client reads those only after it has already chosen a tool. #34659 ruling 6940528935, D5 = A: the open server points to the local skills package, and the `initialize` instructions carry the short selection rule.

## Tests

New file `packages/mcp/src/initialize-selection-rule-34686.test.ts`, 7 tests:

- the rule is present where both dataset tools register: an API key or session, and a `data:read` token, each beside its `tools/list` control;
- a grant without `data:read` (`data:write`, `metadata:write`) gets neither dataset tool name, and `tools/list` lists neither tool;
- a bridge missing any one of the three dataset members gets no rule;
- a bridge that registers only `list_datasets` (no description for `query_dataset`) gets no rule, because the rule names both;
- the install line carries this package's own version (read from `../package.json`), for every grant, and never the operator's `version` (a runtime built with `0.0.1-operator`);
- the host's `instructions` and `dataOnlyInstructions`, and the configured `instructions`, are answered byte-for-byte as given.

<details><summary>Test runs at ae5008be</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` exits 0, then `check:test-typecheck: OK — @objectstack/mcp's test layer compiles under packages/mcp/tsconfig.test.json; 6 file(s) / 53 error(s) / 8 pinned signature(s) held` (debt unchanged; the package `tsconfig.json` excludes `*.test.ts`, which is why the test layer is checked through `tsconfig.test.json`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` (whole package, under the shared verify lock): `Test Files 67 passed (67)`, `Tests 1233 passed (1233)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Targeted run at `b31f2955` (new file, `mcp-dataset-tools.test.ts`, `mcp-server-runtime.authoring-scope.test.ts`): `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 60 passed (60)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one-shot, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored and verified against HEAD)</summary>

The tests import `./mcp-server-runtime.js` from source, so no `dist/` is involved.

1. The data:read gate in `datasetToolDescriptions`: `if (scopes && !scopes.includes(MCP_OAUTH_SCOPE_DATA_READ)) return descriptions;` was replaced by the same line with `&& false` appended. Result: `anchor 1 -> 0`, `blob 8d013899885b -> c783220d5998`, then `× a grant without data:read gets neither dataset sentence (and lists neither tool)`, `Tests 1 failed | 6 passed (7)`. Restore: `blob == HEAD (8d013899885b) and git diff HEAD is empty`.
2. The instructions gate itself: `openServerInstructions(datasetToolsServed(opts.bridge, opts.toolOptions))` was replaced by `openServerInstructions(true || datasetToolsServed(…))`. Result: `anchor 1 -> 0`, then the no-`data:read`, the no-dataset-pair and the list-only tests went red on the instructions assertion (`expected false to be true`), `Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7)`. Restore: `blob == HEAD (9590d8aa8ffa) and git diff HEAD is empty`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The configured-`instructions` path and stdio do not carry the rule or the install line. The reasons are under What changes. If a deployment that sets `instructions` should also get the rule, that is a contract change to the option and a decision for its own card; it is not made here.
- When the dataset rule is sent, it names `aggregate_records` as a fallback, as `DATASET_TOOL_LINES` does. `aggregate_records` registers only where the bridge implements `aggregate`. On `examples/app-crm` it is listed.

## Verification

Live, `examples/app-crm` (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p 38643`, built from `ae5008be`), a fresh HTTP `initialize` per credential. Both credentials were minted on that throwaway instance and discarded with it.

<details><summary>(i) Admin API key (POST /api/v1/keys as the seeded platform admin): 812 bytes, 17 tools listed including list_datasets and query_dataset</summary>

```text
ObjectStack MCP Server. The tools this connection lists depend on what its credential was granted.

For a question about a business number, look for a governed metric first: call list_datasets with the question's business words. A word matches only when it equals a measure's or dimension's name, label or synonym, never a similar word. One measure match: answer with query_dataset. Several matches: ask the user which one they mean; do not pick. No match: fall back to query_records / aggregate_records and say the answer is not from a governed metric.

Published skills: @objectstack/skills 18.5.0. To give a coding agent the ObjectStack procedures, install that version in the project (pnpm add -D @objectstack/skills@18.5.0) and follow the package README to sync the skills into the agent's skills directory.
```

`serverInfo`: `{"name":"objectstack","version":"18.5.0"}`. `tools/list`: list_objects, describe_object, validate_expression, query_records, aggregate_records, get_record, create_record, update_record, delete_record, delete_records, read_file, create_upload_link, list_actions, run_action, resume_run, list_datasets, query_dataset.

</details>

<details><summary>(ii) OAuth access token granted data:write only (dynamic client registration, PKCE authorization code, consent as the admin): 357 bytes, 4 tools listed, no dataset tool</summary>

```text
ObjectStack MCP Server. The tools this connection lists depend on what its credential was granted.

Published skills: @objectstack/skills 18.5.0. To give a coding agent the ObjectStack procedures, install that version in the project (pnpm add -D @objectstack/skills@18.5.0) and follow the package README to sync the skills into the agent's skills directory.
```

Token `scope`: `data:write`. `tools/list`: create_record, update_record, delete_record, create_upload_link.

</details>

<details><summary>Local gates at ae5008be</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 98 families from this diff. All 98 were run, and `--ran` answers `98 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 98 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- 95 exited 0 on the first pass. Three exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, so nothing was measured) and were re-run after fixing the prerequisite; all three then exited 0:
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed a full build: `124 published require entry point(s) across 72 package(s) load`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` also needed a full build: `347 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`.
  - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit, fetched at depth 1: `48 cases pass`.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
- CI check-runs: not yet concluded when this PR was opened. CI convergence is the seat's.

</details>
